description: Repair and cleaning of inter-farm canals, hydraulic structures and pumping stations (Water Resources Service, October 2024) is a data set listed in data.gov.kg, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministry of Water Resources, Agriculture and Processing Industry of Kyrgyzstan. The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Water Resources, Agriculture and Processing Industry of Kyrgyzstan. Its tags are Канал, механикалык тазалоо, ремонт. It offers 1 resource(s) in DOCX. The portal shows 2024-10-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-kg-portal.
